final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and expressly identified no new evidence IDs. The response is mainly a narrower framing of the same record: release-level readiness may be supportable as an operational statement, but policy compliance for launch certification still turns on unresolved predicates. The Actor now concedes that there is no evidence of required disclosure, no evidence of approved risk acceptance, and an open legal review. That narrowing is useful, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats because the caveat is itself an unresolved compliance condition under the stated policy, not a minor qualification around an otherwise satisfied requirement. This is therefore a reinterpretation of unchanged evidence, not an evidence-based improvement in compliance status.
